response.original_title: The Cinematic Orchestra: Ma Fleur Live At The Barbican DVD 06.05 2007
response.overview: The DVD documents The Cinematic Orchestra's concert at the Barbican in London on 6 May 2007. That was the day before the band's album Ma Fleur came out (7 May 2007). Ma Fleur is the group's fourth full-length release and third proper studio album. Jason Swinscoe produced it on Ninja Tune. The Barbican show was a performance of the new album. Heidi Vogel sang on the night, and Swinscoe introduced her during the first disc of the audio recording. Track titles aren't printed on the packaging of the audio release, so the ones listed online come from Swinscoe's announcements or from the studio albums. The final piece is said to be a cover of Stravinsky's "Rite of Spring".
response.title: The Cinematic Orchestra: Ma Fleur Live At The Barbican DVD 06.05 2007
